rows.title: OpenAI job listings signal an in-house ads platform
rows.detail: Job postings describe building advertising infrastructure for ChatGPT.

rows.title: "Code red" pauses ad work
rows.detail: OpenAI redirects resources toward ChatGPT product quality, pausing advertising development.

rows.title: OpenAI announces ads are coming to ChatGPT
rows.detail: Testing planned for adult Free and Go users in the US; Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise stay ad-free. ChatGPT Go launches at $8/month the same day.

rows.title: $60 CPM pricing reported
rows.detail: The Information reports a $60 CPM baseline for ChatGPT placements.

rows.title: US pilot goes live
rows.detail: Ads begin showing to logged-in adult Free and Go users in the US. Launch agencies include Omnicom, WPP and Dentsu; reported minimum commitment $200K–$250K.

rows.title: Albertsons, Target and Williams-Sonoma confirm participation
rows.detail: Retailers announce they are among the first advertisers in the OpenAI ad pilot.

rows.title: First independent ad sightings measured
rows.detail: Adthena finds ads in 0.8% of 500+ analysed prompts; Expedia, Qualcomm, Best Buy and Enterprise Mobility among confirmed advertisers.

rows.title: Criteo becomes first ad tech partner
rows.detail: Criteo connects its advertiser base (~17,000) to the US pilot.

rows.title: Ads Manager dashboard enters testing
rows.detail: A small group of partners gets an early Ads Manager.

rows.title: Former Meta executive hired to lead ad sales
rows.detail: Dave Dugan joins OpenAI to lead global ad solutions.

rows.title: $100M annualised revenue; pilot expands
rows.detail: Reuters reports a $100M annualised run rate six weeks in. Pilot opens in Canada, Australia and New Zealand.

rows.title: Self-serve Ads Manager quietly launches; minimum drops to $50K
rows.detail: CPC bidding appears with $3–$5 recommended bids; minimum commitment cut from $250K to $50K.

rows.title: StackAdapt joins as DSP partner
rows.detail: Ad Age reports StackAdapt is selling ChatGPT inventory.

rows.title: CPMs fall from $60 to as low as $25
rows.detail: Digiday reports buyer CPMs of $25–$35; Ad Age reports some as low as $15.

rows.title: OAI-AdsBot documented
rows.detail: OpenAI adds the OAI-AdsBot landing-page verification crawler to its public bot docs.

rows.title: Ads extend to logged-out users
rows.detail: AdExchanger reports ads appearing for logged-out ChatGPT sessions.

rows.title: Privacy policy updated for ads
rows.detail: OpenAI's US privacy policy discloses receipt of advertiser purchase data.

rows.title: Self-serve Ads Manager beta opens to US advertisers
rows.detail: CPC bidding, a pixel and Conversions API launch; Dentsu, Omnicom, Publicis and WPP plus Adobe, Criteo, Kargo, Pacvue and StackAdapt named partners.

rows.title: Expansion plan for UK, Mexico, Brazil, Japan, South Korea
rows.detail: OpenAI says the pilot will reach five more markets within weeks.

rows.title: Self-serve minimum spend removed
rows.detail: The $50K minimum is dropped for self-serve; daily budgets start at $25.

rows.title: CPA (conversion-optimised) bidding activated
rows.detail: Conversion-optimised campaigns become available in the US self-serve beta.

rows.title: UK becomes first European market
rows.detail: Ads go live in the United Kingdom.

rows.title: Active advertisers jump 46% in a week
rows.detail: Similarweb tracks 2,585 → 3,770 weekly active advertisers; 5,171 unique since 30 March.

rows.title: Policy update opens finance and health categories
rows.detail: Certain US financial-services and health categories become eligible case by case.

rows.title: Product ads gain prices and star ratings
rows.detail: Product feed ads begin showing price and review data.

rows.title: Product carousels, oCPC and URL macros ship
rows.detail: Multi-product carousel, oCPC beta for product feed campaigns and dynamic URL macros.

rows.title: Ads live in UK, Mexico, Brazil, Japan and South Korea
rows.detail: OpenAI confirms the five-market expansion.

rows.title: ChatGPT ads launch in 31 European countries
rows.detail: Consent-first rollout including Germany, France, Spain, Italy and the Netherlands.

rows.title: India launch with ₹725 daily minimum
rows.detail: Ads reach logged-in adults on Free and Go in India; WPP and Omnicom named launch agencies, 50+ brands live.

rows.title: $1B annualised run rate in under 200 days
rows.detail: OpenAI cites 1B+ weekly users, 40+ countries and a $500 credit match for new advertisers.

rows.title: Self-serve opens in India
rows.detail: Indian advertisers get Ads Manager access.

rows.title: AI image and audio tool ads restricted
rows.detail: The Information reports OpenAI stopped approving ads for standalone AI image/audio tools.

rows.title: Sponsored Agents: first AI-native ad format
rows.detail: Select clients test ads that open a chat with the brand's own AI agent; Wayfair in pilot.

rows.title: Shopify storefront integration
rows.detail: ChatGPT Ads integration announced for Shopify merchants.

rows.title: Equativ joins as technology partner
rows.detail: Equativ launches Ad Studio for ChatGPT Ads.

rows.title: Asia expansion takes ChatGPT Ads past 60 countries
rows.detail: Seven more Asian markets including Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.

rows.title: Multi-image visual format during image generation
rows.detail: OpenAI rewrites its ads help article and introduces a multi-image ad format.

rows.title: 26 more countries; 100,000+ advertisers
rows.detail: ChatGPT Ads reaches 89 countries; more than 100,000 advertisers have run campaigns.

rows.title: Multi-image ads open beta in Ads Manager
rows.detail: 4–6 square images sharing one title and body.
